decisions.reason: Selecting a uniformly scaled second V does not change the requirement that the É accent reuse the Hero V terminal geometry.
The source does not change the required peak alignment between the Hero V and É accent.
The approved Hero V remains the unchanged source geometry; the decision concerns how the second V is derived from it.
The requested E/L scale reduction is a composition and cap-height change, not a change to their architectural construction or design language.
Uniformly scaling the approved Hero V into the second V preserves rather than changes the established shared terminal treatment.
The second V remains the same size and retains its established elevation; the source introduces no new explicit hierarchy relation.
The source's E/L scale refinement is already fully represented by the same-message INTRODUCE Event.
The source changes glyph scaling and hierarchy but does not revise the established optical-spacing benchmark or kerning rule.
The source makes a design selection and refinement request but does not change the requirement to provide rationale with review rounds.
The geometric scaling decision does not affect the deferred champagne material treatment.
